tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as perTender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All technical evaluation criteria as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Enclose Scanned copy of Address proof - You must have office in any part of the Karnataka
Enclose Scanned filled and signed Schedule - I Technical Bid-Checklist
Enclose Scanned Filled in and signed Form-A Technical Bid-Form-A
Enclose Scanned Filled in and signed Schedule -II Technical Bid-Schedule -II
GST registration with latest GST clearance certificate should be enclosed
IT returns of the firm for the last 3 years.ie AY 2022-23 to FY 2024-25
Minimum three Performance/Satisfactory Certificates issued by the Govt. or autonomous Institutions past 03 years - should be enclosed. i.e. FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26
Only authorized agencies registered in Transport Department shall be eligible to participate in the tender process and scanned copies of the certificates to be enclosed.
Registration Certificate of the firm - should be enclosed.
Scanned Broachers /Information / Profile of the firm may be furnished.
Scanned Copy of Pan card must be in firm name
Self-Declaration Rs.500-00 Non -Judicial Stamp Paper certified by the Notary to be submitted stating that the entity has not been black listed by any Government and Non-Governmental Departments.
Technical Man Power possessed by the company/dealer/Manufacturer with full details of qualification, experience. - should be enclosed
The bidder should have achieved a minimum financial turnover of Rs.30 Lakhs in at least 2 financial years of the last 5years 2020-21 to 2024-25 - audit reports should be enclosed

The Tenderer shall have successfully provided vehicles for Examination or any other official purpose to Government or autonomous institutions or any other institution. In support of this, the tender shall furnish a certificate duly certified by the Officer of the Dept. / Institution or other documents such as in order or any other relevant documents along with the technical Bid
The vehicle shall not be more than three years old
The Vendor shall have minimum 10 vehicles. The Bidder shall furnish the list of vehicles, its model, fuel mode and other details which would be considered by the university wherever it is necessary.

They should have similar work experience in Tender for providing Vehicles to at least 3 Universities or Govt. Institution scanned copies of the supply orders past 03 years ie. FY 2023-24 toFY 2025-26 should be enclosed
Upload all other document as per tender document
Vehicles Insurance copies should be enclosed
Vehicles Registration copies should be enclosed
